fields.schemeName: Hemoglobinopathy - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide comprehensive care, support, and treatment to patients suffering from Thalassemia and Hemophilia in Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Majadoor Suraksha Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Majdur Suraksha Yojana provides registered rural and agriculture-based labourers in Madhya Pradesh with maternity assistance, scholarships for children, insurance cover and wage-loss compensation. Ensures social security for unorganised workers’ families.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Shaurya Medal Recipients by the Government of Madhya Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to honor and support Shaurya Medal recipients by providing financial aid and recognition for their bravery and distinguished service.

fields.schemeName: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Multiplication Programme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the economic status and productivity of SC/ST farmers by providing high-quality Breeder or Certified I grade seeds for seed production. Beneficiaries receive a 75% subsidy on the cost of the seed for up to 1 hectare of land.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Promotion of Protected Cultivation of Commercial Horticultural Crops
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the protected cultivation of commercial horticultural crops by providing financial assistance to farmers. The scheme supports greenhouse, shade net, low tunnel, plastic mulching, bird/hail net, and cultivation of vegetables and flowers under polyhouse/shade net house.

fields.schemeName: Own Transformer Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide permanent irrigation pump connections to farmers quickly by allowing them to install their own transformers.

fields.schemeName: Police Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to familiarize meritorious students with police functioning and promote research in law enforcement by providing selected students a six-week internship in district police stations under official supervision.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Vegetable Development Program
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase vegetable production in all district headquarters and within a 20 km radius of industrial establishments in Madhya Pradesh through integrated vegetable development.

fields.schemeName: Gomantak Govsamvardhan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the conservation and rearing of Local Breeds of Cattle in the State of Goa. It provides financial assistance of ₹80/- per animal per day to Dairy Farmers or Individuals who are bonafide residents of Goa to encourage responsible stall feeding and conservation practices.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Gramin Street Vendor Rin Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide working capital or low-cost equipment as a loan through banks to support businesses. It benefits poor-class migrant workers and small traders (Street Vendors) in rural areas of Madhya Pradesh, also offering necessary Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training.

fields.schemeName: National Bio Energy Programme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the use of biogas as a clean and renewable energy source, help livestock farmers set up biogas plants, reduce the use of conventional fuels, and support eco-friendly rural development in the state.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by enabling them to establish and operate solar power projects, thereby generating clean energy, providing a sustainable source of income, and encouraging entrepreneurship.

fields.schemeName: Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II) - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the installation of rooftop solar systems among domestic households, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand, enabling consumers to reduce their electricity bills, earn income by feeding surplus power into the grid.

fields.schemeName: Interest Free Loan Scheme To Teachers For The Purchase Of Laptops
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the quality of teaching in schools in the State of Goa by equipping teachers with necessary Information Technology knowledge and skills. It offers an Interest Free Loan up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- for purchasing a Laptop to regular/permanent, full-time teachers.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Giving Stipend to the Trainees Belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community Enrolled under Various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to give benefits under the Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan and Tribal Sub-Plan to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe trainees enrolled under various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa. Eligible trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- to support their training in crafts.

fields.schemeName: State Award To Two Anganwadi Workers Under Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme recognizes Anganwadi Workers under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes for their exemplary performance in improving the quality and coverage of services provided to children and mothers. Each awardee receives a cash award of ₹5,000/- and a citation.

fields.schemeName: Simplification of Sale Process of Herbal Products - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to simplify the sale process of medicinal and aromatic products produced by cultivators, enabling them to legally and easily sell their produce through authorized markets or buyers.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister’s Award for Excellence in Public Administration
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and reward innovative and extraordinary work done by a team of officials to encourage good governance, high standards of services, and replication of best practices. It recognizes outstanding and exemplary performance by a team of officials with a scroll and cash award.

fields.schemeName: Cultivation of Aromatic Plants under MGNREGA - Centre for Aromatic Plants
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage farmers in rural areas to grow aromatic plants by providing them free planting material, technical help, and wage support through MGNREGA.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide stipend and financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. The benefits include financial assistance and stipends for poor students from Class 9th up to normal Three Years Degree Courses (e.g. Bachelor of Arts, Bachelor of Science, etc.

fields.schemeName: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to incentivize units for making their enterprises financially viable. It provides interest subsidy on term loan and/or working capital loan (up to ₹25,00,000/- per year, or ₹27,50,000/- for women/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe applicants) to eligible industries.

fields.schemeName: Incentives to Green Investment Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to incentivize investments by existing and new units in environmentally friendly initiatives. It provides financial support through reimbursement for Water and Energy Audits and Capital Reimbursement for Energy Conservation Equipment to eligible manufacturing units.

fields.schemeName: Shooting Permission Certificate
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to simplify the process of granting official permission for film shooting in Uttarakhand through a single-window online system, ensuring timely approvals and promoting the state as a film-friendly destination.

fields.schemeName: Bee Keeping
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote beekeeping as a sustainable livelihood by providing subsidized bee boxes, bee colonies, and training support to farmers, thereby increasing honey production, enhancing farm income, and strengthening the beekeeping sector in Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Higher Studies
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. This assistance supports students pursuing higher education like MBBS, MBA, and Engineering, including studies within and outside the State or Country.

fields.schemeName: Coaching For Higher Studies
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide coaching to students of Tea Tribes and Adivasi community for preparing them for various competitive examinations like Civil Services, Medical, Engineering, Staff Selection Committee (Graduate level), Banking (Probationary Officers), etc.

fields.schemeName: The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage scholars to undertake research activities in the field of Archaeology of Goa and West Coast based on primary archaeological sources. It offers financial fellowship assistance of up to ₹40,000/- per month to eligible Post-Graduate or PhD scholars for 24 months.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin, Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households in Uttarakhand, ensuring dignified living conditions for economically and socially disadvantaged families.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Purchase of Mobile Sales Van
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to financially assist the Khadi & Village Industries (KVI) Institutions for the purchase of new mobile sales vans for stocking display sales of KVI products and also to, transport of raw materials for producing KVI Products. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Women Entrepreneurs Mahila Udyam Nidhi (MUN)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to meet the equity gap for new Small Scale Industrial units and service activities promoted by women entrepreneurs. It offers Term Loans and Seed Capital for projects costing up to ₹10,00,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Single Window Scheme (PIPDIC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide term loan for fixed assets and loan for working capital through the same agency the total working capital requirement of such units inclusive of all fund based facilities may be taken into account for determining the working capital facility eligible for finance.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Launderers and Barbers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to extend financial assistance to the Launderers and barbers for the purchase of worktables & furniture, etc. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

fields.schemeName: Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote rural tourism and generate local employment by enabling residents to register their homes as certified home-stays that offer safe, affordable accommodation and meal facilities to tourists in Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: License for Repairers of Weights-Measures and Weighing Instruments
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a government-approved license is issued to repairers of weights and measuring instruments, enabling them to repair such instruments used by traders as a means of self-employment and to ensure their livelihood.

fields.schemeName: Free Pre-Recruitment Training
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces to sons of ex-servicemen aged between 16 and 21 years who have passed high school with at least 45% marks.

fields.schemeName: Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Subplan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote fish farming as a sustainable livelihood opportunity among individuals and groups belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Youth Groups
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment & entrepreneurship among rural youth by providing financial support. Financial assistance is provided to Mangal Dals affiliated with the department to help them start employment-oriented projects in 18 identified business sectors.

fields.schemeName: Farmer Pension Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to elderly farmers residing in the state of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1200/- is provided to farmers who are above 60 years of age, own up to 2 hectares of land, and cultivate their own land.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Y.V. Singh Award for Best Thesis in Vegetable Science
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and encourage students for their outstanding research work in the field of Vegetable Science. Under this, a cash award of ₹20,000/- is provided annually to the selected students.

fields.schemeName: Asian Agri-History Foundation Research Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture - All Disciplines)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agriculture across all disciplines by awarding a monthly fellowship of ₹1,200/- for one year.

fields.schemeName: Free Shoe and Bag Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in all government & government-aided schools for purchasing shoes & bags. An amount of ₹318/- per student for Classes 1 to 5 & ₹462/- per student for Classes 6 to 8 is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer.

fields.schemeName: RIMC Scholarship (Military Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month to students from Uttarakhand who are pursuing their education at the Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC).

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Providing Soft Skill Training Courses to Students Studying in State Colleges
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the soft skills of students studying in state colleges of Uttarakhand by providing training through Mahindra Pride Classroom and the Nandi Foundation.

fields.schemeName: Operation of River Rafting / Kayaking Activities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote safe & regulated adventure tourism in the state by allowing licensed rafting companies to operate & issuing certifications to qualified river guides. Under this scheme, rafting companies are granted permission to operate, and licenses are issued to qualified river guides.

fields.schemeName: Sthaniya Fasal Protsahan Karyakram
fields.briefDescription: The program aims to promote the cultivation of local crops, enhance productivity, ensure the use of quality seeds, and provide fair prices to farmers in the mountain districts of Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Gargi Sanskrit Balika Chhaatravrtti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate girl students studying in Classes 6 to 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state by providing financial scholarships to support their education.

fields.schemeName: Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase sugarcane productivity & improve sugar recovery by promoting cultivation of high-quality, high-yielding, & newly developed sugarcane varieties, while providing farmers with financial support, modern cultivation techniques, & access to advanced agricultural technology.

fields.schemeName: Medical Check-Up facility (UKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide medical check-up facilities to registered construction workers through door-to-door visits, health camps, and collection centers.

fields.schemeName: Ex-Gratia Payment for Life-Threatening Injury Requiring Hospital Stay for Treatment
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals who sustain life-threatening injuries due to disasters and require hospitalization for treatment.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance/Pension to Former Renowned Sportspersons
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide lifelong monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹4,000/- to ₹10,000/- in the form of a pension to former renowned sportspersons of Uttarakhand who are above 50 years of age and are financially weak.
